descriptions.raw: Dark, clouded crystals with a brooding translucence, like storm clouds trapped in stone. Smokestone is valued less for brilliance and more for its quiet, understated character. Some say it absorbs light rather than reflecting it.
descriptions.cut: A carefully shaped smokestone, its grey-brown facets muted and subtle. It catches the light reluctantly, revealing hidden depth only at certain angles. Favored by those who prefer discretion over display.
descriptions.sphere: A polished smokestone sphere, dim and subdued. While it holds Stormlight as well as any gem, its muted glow makes infused smokestone easy to overlook, a trait some consider an advantage.
